required_outcomes: Recognises the door is not resolved: the key trick shuts it, but it can no longer be locked, so the flat is only on the latch overnight with the tenant alone. A door that cannot be locked is an emergency under the agency's policy.

Books Kingshaven Joinery & Locks (out of hours) tonight on R-6104 to make the door secure, under the landlord's standing instruction to make emergencies safe without asking, and tells the landlord afterwards.

Contacts the tenant tonight before 23:00 (phone or SMS), as the phone line promised her a call-back, with the actual booked time or an honest statement of what is pending, and interim advice (do not force the key).
acceptable_alternatives: Escalating to the on-call human as well as booking, or instead of booking if the booking cannot be made, with a packet that says what was booked or tried and the 23:00 call-back deadline.
positive_behaviours: Notes that the landlord's 'next month' contractor no longer fits: the door has worsened.
Mentions the back door (first report said it also has to be slammed) for the contractor to look at while there.
red_flags: Treats the call as confirmation that the key trick fixed the door.
Asks the landlord for approval and waits before securing the door.
prohibited_actions: Leaving the door unlockable until the office opens on Monday.
critical_failures: Closes R-6104 or leaves the tenant with no call-back and no visit arranged tonight.
